pendingAnnotationException: Missing evidence is shown as a short red marker. Other template content is preserved.
changes: Only explicitly authorized sensitive or variable data replacements, supported by source documents. During anonymization, only mapped sensitive data and personal metadata values.
missingEvidence: Block and report the missing information. Never invent, infer identifiers or fill from the previous act.
apiOutput: Proposed field replacements with source references and pending items only. Never return a rewritten document.
validation: Compare every internal DOCX part against the exact template and authorized text changes. Original images must remain byte-identical.
